course.title: Software Engineering Specialist
course.description: Postgraduate specialization in Software Engineering at the University of Sao Paulo (USP/ESALQ). The program covered software architecture, design patterns, agile methodologies, project management, and culminated in a Design Thinking capstone project: Atalaia Pro — a SPA/PWA system developed to improve communication in port control, capable of reducing report preparation time by up to 82%.

overview.label: overview
overview.value: System for pawn evaluators to work with gemology, watchmaking, and high-value pens. Developed with Typescript, Next.js, Postgres, JWT, and React Query. Responsive design for desktop and mobile.

description.label: description
description.value: Project of a system for pawn evaluators, currently encompassing three sectors of pawn: gemology, watchmaking, and high-value pens. The gemology section includes tools for calculating the qualities and characteristics of gems. The watchmaking and pens sections allow users to update databases with details and images of each item.

details.label: details
details.value: The system, developed with Typescript using Next.js and supported by Postgres database managed with Prisma, integrates JWT authentication for access control, TanStack Query (React Query) to manage cache and request of data and TanStack Table (React Table) to easy and fast implementation of the tables for the user. Additionally, it maintains a content change log for audit purposes. And it is fully operational and responsive, ensuring seamless operation on the small screens of mobile devices.

overview.label: overview
overview.value: App project designed for music artists, service and equipment providers and potential hirers. It covers UI/UX, frontend, database, and backend. Developed using Typescript, React Native, Postgres and JWT. Compatible with Android and iOS platforms.

description.label: description
description.value: An app created to facilitate communication between music artists and potential hirers, providing a platform for artists to showcase their talents and for event producers to articulate their needs for finding suitable performers. Additionally, it serves as a platform for service and equipment providers to showcase their offerings.

details.label: details
details.value: The project covers UI/UX research, designing, prototyping, frontend and backend development and database architecture. Developed using Typescript within React Native, with Postgres as a primary database solution. The authentication system relies on JWT (JSON Web Tokens). The application is optimized for speed, lightweight functionality, and is operational on both Android and iOS platforms, ensuring a flawless user experience.

overview.label: overview
overview.value: Personal project of a finance app designed for ease and efficiency, covering UI/UX, frontend, database, and backend. Developed using Typescript, React Native, Postgres and JWT, it operates on both Android and iOS platforms.

description.label: description
description.value: This personal project aimed to replace traditional paper-based financial notes with an easy and optimized solution. The objective was to create a simple, straightforward, and user-friendly tool to facilitating efficient financial organization.

details.label: details
details.value: The complete project encompassed UI/UX research, design, prototyping, frontend and backend development, and database architecture. Developed using Typescript in React Native, with Postgres serving as the primary database solution and employing JWT authentication. The application is optimized for speed, lightweight functionality, and seamless operation on both Android and iOS platforms, ensuring and optimal user experience.

overview.label: overview
overview.value: A modern SPA/PWA system for a port control station that replaces error-prone manual Excel reports with an automated, real-time maneuver forecast platform for maritime pilots.

description.label: description
description.value: Atalaia Pro streamlines operational communication at the Atalaia control room by replacing manual spreadsheet-based maneuver forecasts with an automated, real-time system. Built as a Progressive Web App, it works offline and on mobile devices -- essential for maritime pilots at sea. Features include automatic data import, dynamic schedule management, multi-scenario forecast support, and instant updates. Usability testing showed an 82% reduction in report preparation time compared to the previous Excel-based workflow.

details.label: details
details.value: Single Page Application with PWA offline support. Replaces manual Excel-based reports with automated forecast generation. Schedule management simplified with drag-and-drop. Real-time updates for pilots. Responsive design for control room large monitors and small mobile devices. Import algorithm extracts data from external sources. Progressive Web App enables offline access and home screen installation. 82% reduction in report preparation time validated through usability testing.

api-backend.title: API & Backend Systems
api-backend.context: Designing and implementing reliable server-side architectures — REST APIs, database modeling, authentication systems, and observability pipelines.
api-backend.applicability: Applied across 4 backend projects: Fastify 5 APIs with Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL (Atalaia Pro — 80+ endpoints, role-based auth with 6 user groups), Koa 2 with raw SQL and Firebase OAuth (Music Market — 19 tables, 80+ endpoints), Express with Sequelize on MariaDB (Budget), and a Fastify podcast API with full Zod schema validation and auto-generated Swagger docs.
api-backend.impact: Delivered production APIs handling authentication, soft deletes, pagination, filtering, and multi-tenant operations. All projects include CI/CD pipelines, Docker Compose orchestration, and observability via OpenTelemetry and Sentry.

frontend-engineering.title: Modern Frontend Engineering
frontend-engineering.context: Building performant, accessible, and visually refined single-page applications using component-driven architecture, type-safe development, and modern tooling.
frontend-engineering.applicability: Leveraged across 4 frontend projects: a React 19 PWA with offline IndexedDB cache, TypeScript 6, Zustand, and TanStack Query/Table (Atalaia Pro — 12 pages, 60+ components, dual router trees for auth); a Next.js 16 app with Prisma 7 and full audit trail (Penhor — 14 pages, 24 DB tables); a React 18 admin dashboard with Zustand and Tailwind 3 (Music Market — 12 routes); and this bilingual portfolio with i18next and code-as-UI aesthetic.
frontend-engineering.impact: Delivered PWAs with offline support, role-based UI filtering, drag-and-drop UX, and consistent design systems. Established reusable component libraries, type-safe API contracts, and automated CI/CD builds across projects.

mobile.title: Mobile Development
mobile.context: Creating cross-platform native mobile applications for Android and iOS using React Native with shared TypeScript business logic.
mobile.applicability: Delivered 3 mobile applications from scratch: a personal finance app (Bolso Bom) with React Native, PostgreSQL backend, and JWT authentication; the Music Market community marketplace app connecting musicians and producers; and a social podcast app with chat rooms, media management, and user group permissions.
mobile.impact: Developed fully functional native apps with cross-platform TypeScript code reuse, secure authentication, push notifications, and REST API integration. Managed the full development lifecycle from UI/UX design through backend architecture and deployment.

devops.title: DevOps & Infrastructure
devops.context: Managing self-hosted production infrastructure on VPS environments — container orchestration, observability stacks, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
devops.applicability: Designed and maintain a complete LGTM observability platform (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Prometheus) with 9 containerized services on rootless Podman, 14 alert rules, 8 provisioned dashboards, and SLO-based alerting at 99.5% availability. All 6 production projects run Docker/Podman Compose with GitHub Actions CI/CD, SSH-based deploys, Nginx reverse proxies, and PostgreSQL exporter monitoring.
devops.impact: Established a self-healing infrastructure with automatic deploy rollbacks, Telegram + email alert routing, multi-window error budget tracking, and 30-day log/metric retention. Enabled full-stack observability — logs, metrics, and distributed traces — across all deployed applications.

ux-strategy.title: UX Strategy & Design
ux-strategy.context: Applying user-centered design methodology from discovery research through high-fidelity prototyping — blending analytical rigor with creative problem-solving.
ux-strategy.applicability: Led 3 complete freelance UI/UX design projects using modern methodologies. Conducted user interviews, competitor analysis, proto-personas, journey mapping, CSD matrices, wireframes, usability testing, and delivered high-fidelity prototypes in Figma. Applied this design foundation across all development projects.
ux-strategy.impact: Received consistently positive client feedback for simplified approaches, attention to detail, and actionable research insights. The design methodology now informs all development work — every project begins with user-centered analysis before a single line of code.

description.label: description
description.value: Planning and creation of digital products and services, focusing on user experience and interface design.

work.label: work
work.value: I developed four complete projects, starting with research, user interviews, competitor analysis, proto-personas, user journey mapping, CSD matrix, UX metrics, maps and flows, wireframes, usability testing, to branding and high-fidelity prototypes, among other elements.

tools.label: tools
tools.value: I adopted the Design Thinking methodology to conduct my projects, using Figma as one of the main tools.

achievements.label: achievements
achievements.value: I received positive feedback on all projects for the simplified approach, attention to detail, and appreciation for the results and information provided.

description.label: description
description.value: Development of responsive web projects and native mobile applications.

work.label: work
work.value: While developing two responsive web platforms using Next.js and two native mobile applications for Android and iOS with React Native CLI, I managed both the frontend and backend, including the implementation of API, secure authentication, and database.

tools.label: tools
tools.value: Initially, I gained proficiency in languages like C, JavaScript, and Swift, and configured VPS servers using Nginx, Apache, Postgres, MariaDB, NodeJS, Docker, Git and PM2 for project hosting. I developed smaller projects using C, PHP, ViteJS, Express, MongoDB, Strapi, Bootstrap, Swift, and pure JavaScript. Currently, I focus on tools such as Git, VSCode, Node, Typescript, NextJS, ViteJS, TailwindCSS, Docker, Jest, and JWT (JSON Web Token), using them as primary resources in project development.

achievements.label: achievements
achievements.value: My projects include tools under implementation in a port movements control room, contributing to daily operations. Developing and maintaining operational a pawn evaluation platform, a financial control solution, and a local music market service hiring application. While developing complex tables with selection, filtering, and sorting features, I opted to use the TanStack React Table and React Query libraries for cache management, resulting in significant performance improvements. Additionally, to address slow select inputs due to the large list of items, I implemented React Window to optimize rendering, significantly improving form performance and user experience. All products were delivered before the deadline, allowing for enhancements. Despite being my first professional projects, they received the due attention to detail.
